budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Supply two cloth orders per villager before the fair closes. Growing flax, borrowing tools, exchanging material, repairing shared machines and committing labor all compete with private delivery deadlines.
task.natural_termination: Natural completion when every villager has delivered two orders, or at step 80 when the fair closes. H=96 is a separate upper bound; natural cause has priority and is absorbing.
task.interaction: Actual adjacent tools can be lent, returned and recalled. Spinner and loom have exclusive job/output slots and depleting condition. Two-step labor promises may advance another owners job and block the helpers next action. Finite material gifts and repairs enable partners production.
task.observation_access: Map, positions, materials, plots, machine condition, job reservation, output, labor and tool loans are public. A role alone knows its private early-delivery deadline. Tool owners are fixed common knowledge 0 for sickle and 1 for shuttle.

native_event_definitions.meaning: One-unit material handoff count by giver
One cloth order delivered this step
Actual labor units applied to each facility
Facility finished its reserved job this step
Tool returned or physically reclaimed this step

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
